title: #100 - The Leader Is Tywin
content:
#100 - The Leader Is Tywin

Chapter 100 The leader is Tywin

The defense near Duke Tywin's tent was still very tight. In a few breaths, dozens of Lion soldiers holding torches rushed out.

A Lion officer saw Arthur leading the charge and shouted:

"Where are the enemies? Whose lord are you subordinates to?"

Arthur pointed his sword at the tent, "The enemy has already entered here, and we are ordered to protect Lord Tywin."

After that, he ignored these Lion soldiers and rushed to the tent with his men.

Seeing this situation, the Lion officer immediately turned his face, "They are the enemy, stop them."

The Lion soldiers were still in a daze, but the people who robbed the camp had been prepared for a long time.

The two waves of people started fighting directly, and the sound of swords hitting each other suddenly rang loudly.

The member of the Blood Opera Troupe who held the knife for Arthur also handed the golden Guandao to him in time, which made Arthur's charge less obstructed.

Everyone was still fighting, and suddenly several people rushed out of the tent.

Arthur looked closely and saw that it was Lord Tywin and his personal attendants.

However, the majestic Westerly Guardian was a little disheveled. He was without the scarlet cape with gold lines that he usually wore. He was only wearing a breastplate and silk casual clothes, and only one iron boot.

He was supported by the people around him and walked away from the battlefield with a group of personal soldiers.

"Lord Tywin is in front of us. Protect Tywin." Arthur shouted.

He casually chopped down the two Lion Family soldiers in front of him, and then led his men to chase the Westerly Guardian.

However, the fight of hundreds of people attracted a lot of attention, and more Lion Family soldiers came out from all around.

There were also sounds from the surrounding tents, and it seemed that the soldiers who were sleeping and resting had also woken up.

The situation became more unfavorable, but fortunately, the Lion Family soldiers who joined later did not understand the situation for the time being, and stood around, watching the two groups of their own people fighting.

The Lion family officer who had previously identified Arthur as an enemy shouted: "This group of light cavalry is the enemy, hurry up and come on."

"We are all soldiers ordered to protect Lord Tywin, they are the enemy." Ma Ke followed Arthur and was the most relaxed, so he refuted.

Arthur waved his sword and shouted: "That's right, they are trying to disrupt us, brothers, hurry up and take down these river people."

In the few breaths that the later Lion family soldiers hesitated, the first red robes had been almost wiped out.

The officer was also hit by Arthur's sword, and his head was moved immediately.

This made the front of the camp robbers unobstructed, and they went straight to the West Guardian who was still in sight.

The sharpshooter Ange played steadily, and the number of people around Duke Tywin continued to decrease.

It was just that the Westerlanders were still loyal, and the Westerland Guardian was protected by the personal soldiers with a large shield behind him, so he could not be shot to death for the time being.

After the torch light illuminated the golden color of Arthur's Guandao, the later Lion family soldiers finally reacted and hurriedly followed the camp robbers who ran over.

"The enemy is ahead, protect Lord Tywin."

"The man with the golden knife is Arthur Bracken, stop him quickly."

"Don't sleep, pigs in the tent, come out and fight."

In order to make things more chaotic, the camp robbers also shouted:

"The ones behind are the Rivermen, brothers, fight them."

"The enemy pretends to be Lord Tywin's personal soldiers, don't confuse them with our own people."

"Colleagues in the tent, recognize that we are here to protect Lord Tywin."

In this way, Tywin, several attendants and twenty or thirty personal soldiers were in front, and the camp robbers followed behind, followed by a large group of Lion Family soldiers.

The moonlight was unclear, and the weak torchlight illuminated the current situation of the Westerly Camp.

After running for a while, the Westerly Guard was helped to the stable, and then surrounded by personal soldiers and attendants, riding out of the camp.

Now the enemy is wearing the equipment of the Lion Family soldiers, and it is impossible to distinguish between the enemy and us. Running out of the camp is indeed a way to deal with it.

Arthur and his men also ran to the stables, each with a horse, and they jumped on their horses and chased after the robbers.

Now the camp robbers didn't need to disguise themselves.

The crowd galloped on their horses, chasing and fleeing, breaking the tranquility of the night.

"The one without a red robe in front is Tywin." Arthur pointed his knife to the front and turned to remind the camp robbers, "Chase Tywin."

Ange understood, and pulled the long bow like a full moon, and a sharp arrow shot out instantly.

A servant shouted: "Don't hurt my master."

Then he stood behind his own lord and blocked the arrow with his body.

The Westerlands were reminded, and someone handed his scarlet robe to the lord, and started to ride fast again.

Arthur glanced clearly, turned back and shouted: "The bald man is Tywin, shoot Tywin."

Ange shot another arrow, and the Westerlands man who handed the red robe blocked the arrow with his body and fell to the ground.

Someone else put his lion-shaped half-helmet on the lord, and now Arthur couldn't tell that the one in front was Duke Tywin.

Fortunately, Marco Piper was quick-witted and shouted: "The one with the head is Tywin, chase Tywin."

Although the Westerlands were nervous, they still had brains and didn't cut off their lord's head.

Then, the large army of the Westerlands finally caught up.

Arthur looked back and saw dense torches, at least hundreds of people, shouting and cursing from a distance.

But the distance between them and Tywin was getting closer and closer, estimated to be thirty or forty steps away.

Anguy also stopped shooting, and there was not much stock in his quiver.

Just when the raiders were about to catch up with the target, a large group of light cavalry from the Westerlands suddenly flashed in the west.

They heard the shouts of Arthur and others and rushed to protect their lord.

"Sir, don't worry, I am Amory Lodge." The leader shouted. Regardless of whether he stopped the pursuer or not, he must first clearly demonstrate his role in saving the pursuer.

Rocky was originally sent to hunt down Lord Beric and other members of the Brotherhood Without Banners, and he happened to catch up to Harrenhal in the past two days.

Half of Loch's more than a hundred light cavalry were sent to fight the pursuers, and he took the rest with Lord Tywin.

"My lord, don't panic. As long as I am Amory Lodge, these river people can't hurt you at all."

This person was afraid that the panicked Lord Feng would not know who he was, so he mentioned his name repeatedly.

The function of rescuing a chariot is a great achievement that can be compared with the function of following the dragon.

Everyone in the robbery camp was stopped, and the distance began to widen.

Such a good opportunity may not be available next time.

Arthur made a decision immediately: "Soldiers from various families in the river are fighting with them. People from the Blood Troupe are coming with me."

Most of the soldiers of the various families in the river are elite infantry. Although they can ride horses, they are not good at fighting on horseback while running.

These people from the Blood Troupe are used to fighting on the spot, so they are suitable to be led to chase them.

So more than thirty soldiers from various families in the river stayed to entangle Loki's men, and the remaining twenty-five followed Arthur to hunt down Tywin.

"Drive, drive, drive." Everyone urged the horses desperately.

In a dozen breaths, the distance between the two sides narrowed to dozens of steps again.

Everyone in the Western Territory was a little panicked. After some prevarication, the lower-ranking Rocky and his light cavalry were left to intercept the pursuers.

Rocky was angry, but he didn't dare to make a mistake in front of Tywin, so he obediently led his remaining fifty or so men to intercept the pursuers.

"Wag brought the blood troupe to stop them." Arthur shouted without wasting any time.

He himself led Ma Ke and An Gai to pursue Tywin.

There are only a dozen people around the Western Guardian now.

An Gai drew his bow and shot again, and another Westerner fell to the ground.

As he rode his horse past the man's body, Arthur glanced and saw it wasn't Tywin.

"I, Rocky, will risk my life to protect you."

There was another loud shouting behind him, and when Arthur looked back, he saw that this old enemy was chasing after him again.

But Rocky was not as brave as he said. Instead, he asked his men to stop the three of Arthur and went straight after the lord.

The time has come for me, Amory Lodge, to show my loyalty and bravery in front of my lord.

Arthur swung his sword and hacked two light cavalry to death with two blows.

But there were twenty or thirty people in this group, and the blood troupe behind them only held back about the same number of Western soldiers as themselves.

Seeing Tywin running further and further away, Arthur was extremely anxious.

After this camp robbery, the Western Border Army will surely strengthen its night defense. In other words, this may be the only chance to kill Tywin.

"Go quickly, An Gai and I will hold them back." Ma Ke shouted.

After killing a Western Soldier, Arthur Lema shouted:

"Two good brothers, please hold on."

Then catch up.

The distance between Arthur and the target ahead was once again narrowed, but this time, the situation was even more unfriendly.

After passing a hill, hundreds of torches appeared.

The soldiers who guarded Tywin went around half a circle and came back.

"I am Davon Lannister, uncle, please feel free to come in." A messenger shouted from among the Western soldiers in front.

So the soldiers escorting Tywin took the guards of the west and rode towards the west soldiers.

"There are enemies behind, shoot them." Rocky shouted at Davon's men from a distance.

The soldiers of the Western Region had obviously received the order from their superiors. After a while of preparation, the first round of arrows was shot out.

There was a loud swishing sound in the air.

Arthur was still desperately trying to close the distance with Tywin, but he felt something was wrong.

Looking up, he suddenly felt bad.

The arrows from the sky fell like a heavy rain. Although he, wearing the armor of the Western Light Cavalry, could bear it, the horse under his crotch could not bear it.

The horse lost its front hooves and fell to its knees on the spot, knocking Arthur off the horse.

Fortunately, he took his feet out of the stirrups in time, rolled over, and stood up.

The distance between Tywin on horseback and Arthur on his feet began to widen.

"Hey!" He sighed sadly.

In order to save himself, Arthur suddenly pulled out the great sword Shuoyue from his waist, held the sword hilt upside down, looked at the back of a figure who looked very much like Tywin, and threw it at this person with all his strength.

Before he could carefully check whether the sword had hit or not, the second round of arrow rain had already fallen.

Without a large shield to protect him, he suddenly became a "porcupine" covered in arrows.

Although the protection of the iron armor and helmet, as well as the thick blood brought by the iron bone skill, make such minor injuries not a big problem, it is not very painful either.

"Master Arthur, come quickly, Master Ma Ke and I can't hold on any longer." At this moment, An Gai's voice sounded.

This is a taciturn Dornish man. Although the relationship is only an employment relationship, he completes a series of instructions to Arthur without compromise.

If he calls for help, the situation is really dangerous.

Arthur glanced at the target that had rushed into the formation of the Westerners, and then at the third round of arrow rain still floating in the sky, knowing that he would not be able to get Tywin's head tonight.

He no longer hesitated, turned around and ran in the direction of Ma Ke and An Gai.

"Hold on, I'm here, Arthur." Climbing up the hill they just crossed, the two men and a dozen Western soldiers who fought in a bloody battle appeared in front of Arthur.

Ma Ke, who was riding a horse, was surrounded and beaten by seven or eight Western Light Cavalry. He moved slowly and was already seriously injured.

Ange got a spear from somewhere, and fought fiercely with four or five light cavalrymen.

Arthur strode forward to the battlefield, killed a westerlander with a knife, took down his body, then jumped on his horse and joined the battle.

A few minutes later, ten westerlanders were killed by Arthur, and the living westerlanders fled in all directions.

Ma Ke was seriously injured. After seeing the enemy running away, he smiled at Arthur and fell off his horse.

Arthur and Ange hurriedly dismounted and ran over to check his injuries.

"I'm fine." Mako smiled weakly with black blood flowing from the corner of his mouth, "Did you kill Tywin? If you kill him, there will be no war in the Riverlands."

Arthur was full of shame, "Good brother, I, my horse was shot down by a rain of arrows, I couldn't catch up with him, and threw a man with a sword. I think I hit him, but that person may not be Tywin."

Mako's expression was visibly depressed, "It's too dark at night, it's normal that you can't see clearly."

Although he was injured, he was still counseling Arthur.

Arthur was about to say something, but heard Anguy calling out urgently:

"Since Tywin can't be killed, take Lord Mako to Harrenhal to bandage his wounds. He can still be saved."

Mako said: "That's right, I also think I can save him."

The three of them stopped hesitating, Arthur picked a strong horse, carried Mako on the horse, and ran towards Harrenhal with Anguy.

Most of the other raiders were stopped by the Amoris, and they were in danger at this moment, so they couldn't take care of it.

After about half an hour of galloping, the three men and two horses arrived at the gate of Harrenhal. They went around to the east gate, called the guards at the gate, and then entered the castle.

"Go find the maesters of Harrenhal, and the monks who came in these days, too. We need help, hurry up."

As soon as he walked out of the cave, Arthur ordered the guards at the gate.

Many river monks entered the castle. They claimed that they were not here for refuge, but to help the refugees who had left their homes.

Many monks can treat diseases, so they can be used as doctors.

The two people on duty ran to perform this task, and the rest of the people worked together to close the heavy iron door.

Marco was already unconscious, and Arthur carried him to the Kingsburning Tower. Anguy himself was also injured and needed bandages and treatment, so he followed behind.

Not long after, the old maesters of Harrenhal and some monks arrived one after another.

"I think the first thing to do is to let him drink some poppy milk, and then drain the blood clots. As for whether to induce vomiting, it depends on the efficacy of these two things." The old scholar stroked his white beard and said quite proudly.

He was very confident in his medical skills.

This made Arthur happy. The population of the Hean family in Harrenhal was declining, and this man must have put in a lot of effort.

He was really capable of bleeding a person who was cut and bleeding.

"Go away." He waved to the old scholar, and then faced several monks, "Come on, give some feasible suggestions."

An elderly but strong monk said quickly: "First clean the wound, use my herbs to stop the bleeding, then bandage it, and then take some blood-producing medicine tonic, maybe it can save his life."

"Okay, let's do it." Arthur agreed to this treatment plan and asked the man to implement it quickly.

The man took action, and several monks also helped him.

The old scholar looked at the busy people with contempt, shook his head, and walked out.

While the monks were treating Ma Ke's wound, Arthur suddenly saw a man's face clearly.

This man looked middle-aged, with a round face, bald head, and quite kind features, wearing a light gray robe.

What shocked Arthur was that this man looked very much like the Pope of a certain religion in his previous life.

This face is not long!

He asked this man tentatively: "Big Sparrow?"
